hero.intro: Butterfly valves isolate and regulate large flows in a short, light body. A rubber-lined concentric valve suits water, utilities and chemicals at low pressure; a double offset valve with a PTFE seat takes process duty to Class 600; a triple offset valve seals metal to metal for steam, hydrocarbons and high temperature, with zero leakage and fire-safe design.

guidance.heading: How many offsets the duty needs
guidance.body: Concentric valves are the economical choice for water and low-pressure services where a rubber liner can take the temperature. Double offset moves the disc off the seat as it opens, cutting wear and torque, and suits PTFE seats to about 200 °C. Triple offset adds a conical seat angle so the disc never rubs, which lets it seal metal to metal at high pressure and temperature, and in cryogenic service.

categories.seoDescription: Cryogenic gate, globe, check, ball and butterfly valves to BS 6364 for LNG, LPG and air separation to -196 °C, and vacuum-jacketed liquid hydrogen valves to -253 °C.

hero.intro: Valves for liquefied gases. An extended bonnet keeps the stem packing warm, above the cold zone, so it stays elastic and seals; austenitic stainless bodies keep their toughness at -196 °C; and every design is cold-tested. For liquid hydrogen at -253 °C, vacuum-jacketed bodies and insulated stems keep heat out and boil-off down.

guidance.heading: What makes a valve cryogenic
guidance.body: Three things: materials that stay tough at the service temperature (304, 316 and their low-carbon grades, or forged equivalents), an extended bonnet long enough that the packing stays above freezing, and a way for trapped liquid to escape when it warms (a vented ball or gate cavity), so the valve does not over-pressurise. Cold testing to BS 6364 proves the seat and the packing at temperature.

standards.heading: Built and tested for cold service
standards.body: Cryogenic valves are designed to ASME B16.34 and BS 6364, with project specifications such as Shell SPE 77/200 applied when the order calls for them. Ball valves follow ISO 21011 for cryogenic service and API 6D or ISO 17292 for the valve itself; gate, globe and check valves follow API 600, 602 and 603, BS 1873 and BS 1868. Cold tests are run in liquid nitrogen with helium.

hero.intro: A valve and its actuator supplied and tested as one unit. Electric actuators suit remote and networked control where power is available; pneumatic actuators give fast, fail-safe operation on plant air; hydraulic and gas-over-oil actuators supply the torque that large pipeline valves need, using line gas where there is no other power on site.

guidance.heading: Power, speed and fail position
guidance.body: Start from what power the site has (electricity, instrument air, hydraulic supply or line gas), how fast the valve must move, and what it must do when power is lost: fail closed, fail open or stay put. Spring-return pneumatic and hydraulic actuators fail to a set position; electric actuators hold position unless fitted with a fail-safe unit. Send the valve data sheet and the control signal.

hero.intro: A plug valve turns a tapered or cylindrical plug a quarter turn to open or close. In a sleeved plug valve a PTFE sleeve lines the body and seals all round the plug, so there is no body cavity for product to collect in, no lubricant to inject, and tight shut-off in both directions.

products.title: Concentric Butterfly Valve, Rubber Lined
products.descriptionShort: Concentric (zero offset) butterfly valves with a fully rubber-lined body: NPS 2" to 72", Class 125/150 and PN6 to PN16, wafer, lug or double-flanged, EPDM, NBR or FKM liner.
products.descriptionLong:
The economical butterfly valve for water, cooling water, utilities and many chemicals. The stem runs through the centre of the disc, and the disc closes into a rubber liner that covers the whole bore, so the fluid touches only the liner and the disc and never the body.

A butterfly valve closes by turning a disc a quarter turn across the bore. The body is short and light for its size, which is why butterfly valves take over from gate and ball valves on large lines, in water, utility, process and pipeline service.

Construction

  • Fully rubber-lined body; EPDM, NBR or FKM (Viton) liner to suit the fluid
  • Disc in ductile iron, stainless steel or coated, on a one-piece or two-piece stem
  • Wafer, lug or double-flanged body
  • Lever up to about 8", gear operator above, or actuator on an ISO 5211 top flange

Sizes and ratings

Published range: NPS 2" to 72" (DN50 to DN1800), Class 125/150, PN6 to PN16, in ductile iron, carbon steel, stainless steel, bronze. End connections: Wafer, lug, double flanged. Operation: lever, gear operator, pneumatic, electric or hydraulic actuator.

products.title: Hydraulic, Electro-Hydraulic and Gas-over-Oil Actuated Valves
products.descriptionShort: Ball, gate and butterfly valves fitted with hydraulic, electro-hydraulic or gas-over-oil (pneumatic-hydraulic) actuators: high torque for large pipeline valves, with line-break detection and ESD.
products.descriptionLong:
For the largest valves and the most remote sites. Hydraulic actuators deliver high torque with smooth, stable travel; self-contained electro-hydraulic units need only power and a 4-20 mA or on-off signal; gas-over-oil actuators run on the pipeline gas itself, with a hand pump for manual operation, so a block valve station needs no external power at all.

An actuated valve opens and closes on a signal rather than by hand. The valve, actuator, mounting kit and controls are matched for torque and speed, assembled, and function-tested together before dispatch, so the package arrives ready to connect.

Construction

  • Hydraulic: external hydraulic supply, high torque, precise positioning
  • Electro-hydraulic: self-contained pump and reservoir, 4-20 mA control
  • Gas-over-oil: line gas or nitrogen drives oil to the cylinder; hand pump for manual operation
  • Line-break detection, local and remote control, emergency shutdown

Sizes and ratings

Published range: NPS 2" to 120", depending on valve type, ASME Class 150 to 2500, in carbon steel, stainless steel, alloy steel, duplex. End connections: Flanged, butt-weld, wafer or lug. Operation: hydraulic, electro-hydraulic or gas-over-oil actuator.

The full dimension and weight table for each class is issued with the quotation, together with the general arrangement drawing for the end connection and operator you choose.

Testing and documents

Valve tests to API 598 or API 6D, and function tests of the valve and actuator together, with the material certificates and the pressure-test record supplied with the valve. Third-party inspection and extra tests are added when the order specifies them.

Supply

Hydraulic actuated valves are supplied from Dubai to projects, plants and maintenance teams across the GCC, the wider Middle East and Africa. Most are built to the order specification, so delivery depends on size, class, material and operator; standard carbon-steel sizes move fastest. We review the data sheet before quoting and flag anything that needs clarifying, such as a missing pipe schedule or an operator torque that has not been sized.

faqs.question: When is a gas-over-oil actuator the right choice?
faqs.answer: At pipeline block valve stations with no power or air supply. The actuator uses line gas, so it can close the valve on a line break detected by its own controls.

faqs.question: Which valve sizes can be actuated?
faqs.answer: Soft-seated ball valves to 56", metal-seated ball valves to 44", gate valves to 66" and butterfly valves to 120", depending on type and class.

products.descriptionShort: Sleeved non-lubricated plug valves: NPS 1/2" to 24", ASME Class 150 to 600, PTFE sleeve, cavity-free, bi-directional, RF, RTJ or butt-weld, lever, gearbox or actuator.
products.descriptionLong:
A quarter-turn valve for refining, petrochemical, coal chemical, gas, LPG and general industrial service. A PTFE sleeve locked into the body seals all the way round the plug, so there is no cavity to trap product and no sealant to inject; the seal can be adjusted in service by tightening the top cap.

A plug valve is a quarter-turn valve with a plug in place of a ball. Its large sealing area and straight flow path make it a simple, tight-sealing valve for on-off duty, and the sleeved design needs no lubricant.

Construction

  • PTFE sleeve locked into the body, sealing round the full plug
  • Cavity-free, bi-directional
  • Adjustable seal by top-cap loading
  • Lever, gearbox, pneumatic or electric actuator

faqs.question: Plug valve or ball valve?
faqs.answer: A sleeved plug valve has no body cavity, so it suits fluids that would collect or polymerise in a ball valve cavity, and it seals tightly at low pressure. A ball valve has lower torque at large sizes.

faqs.question: What temperatures can the PTFE sleeve take?
faqs.answer: Typically -29 °C to about 200 °C, depending on pressure. For higher temperatures, ask about alternative sleeve materials.
